name: Georgia
agency: Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS)

period.description: Each month is its own spenddown budget period, reviewed in six-month blocks.

submission.description: Give your medical bills to DFCS, for example by uploading them through Georgia Gateway or a DFCS self-service kiosk. Bills for a past period must be turned in within three months after that period ends.

notes: Bills count if still unpaid on the first of the month, or if you got the care or paid the bill that month.
To use an unpaid bill in a different month than when you got care, sign the Medically Needy Option Statement.
If you pay your own Medicare premium, it is counted first each month.
The part of a bill Medicare or other insurance should pay does not count.
